snippet.title: FrostBound - Gameplay Trailer | Coming soon to Steam Next Fest JUNE 2025
snippet.description:
FrostBound is a single-player roguelike deck-building game. Set in a world gripped by an endless winter, FrostBound challenges players to build and defend their bases using a vast array of over 500 cards.

🎮 You can try the DEMO on Steam for free NOW!
